nodes.name: agent_golden.json
nodes.summary: Tool-routing golden set (v1, 33 cases) for the screening assistant: each chat message lists tools that must be called (expect/expect_any), tools that must not run (forbid), or no_tools, covering counting, listing, export, criteria, screening, PubMed, web, extraction, memory and injection cases.

nodes.name: golden.json
nodes.summary: Golden set v2 (68 cases) for the end-to-end research eval: answerable questions with expected answers, required facts and verbatim PDF quotes across six papers, plus unanswerable, false-premise, scope, isolation, injection and wrong-paper trap cases.

nodes.name: golden_v1.json
nodes.summary: Archived v1 golden set (26 cases) on EA2022 and JPan2023 for the 'main' and 'isolation' projects, covering answerable, unanswerable, false-premise, scope, isolation and injection questions; superseded by golden.json v2.

nodes.name: golden_v2_review.md
nodes.summary: Researcher review sheet for golden set v2: a table of the 42 new and 5 edited cases (question, expected answer, quote/page, OK column) for human sign-off before v2 becomes a baseline; quotes are pre-checked by evals.check_golden.
